payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

program.instruction: Change the background into a basketball court
program.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

requirements.text: Change the background into a basketball court
requirements.source_phrase: Change the background into a basketball court

outcomes.description: Change the image background into a basketball court.

nodes.question: Is the background itself recognizably a basketball-court setting, rather than merely containing basketball-related objects?
nodes.criteria: pass only when the background as a whole reads as a basketball-court setting; a hoop, balls, or markings alone do not automatically establish recognizability. fail when it is clearly not recognizable as a court. unknown only when evidence is genuinely insufficient or conflicting. Cite contextual setting cues and distinguish them from isolated props.
nodes.binding: Compare SOURCE and EDITED backgrounds. Assess whether the requested background replacement itself depicts a recognizable basketball-court setting, not whether basketball objects are present.

nodes.question: Is there visible, basketball-court-directed progress in changing the background, even if it is not a recognizable complete court?
nodes.criteria: pass when the background shows specific visible progress toward a basketball-court replacement; fail when no such progress is visible. unknown only when evidence is genuinely insufficient or conflicting. Basketball props or court-like alterations may support progress without proving completion.
nodes.binding: Compare SOURCE and EDITED backgrounds; judge only specific progress toward the requested background replacement, not overall completion.

nodes.question: Does the edited background show a court-like playing surface or recognizable court markings?
nodes.criteria: pass when a court-like playing surface or recognizable court markings are visible in the background; fail when they are clearly absent; unknown only when visibility or evidence is insufficient. Judge surface/markings, not basketball props.
nodes.binding: Inspect only the edited background for court-surface and marking evidence; do not decide overall fulfillment.

nodes.question: Using all three saved support observations, what is the fulfillment state for changing the background into a basketball court?
nodes.criteria: Use only n1, n2, and n4. complete when n1 passes. partial when n1 fails and n2 passes. absent when n1 and n2 fail. unknown when evidence is insufficient, either required status is unknown, or statuses do not establish a state. n4 supplies surface/marking evidence for faithful composition but does not independently determine fulfillment. Cite all support IDs; do not make new visual judgments or count unrelated edits as progress.
nodes.binding: Compose the independent visual findings about the requested background change; no images are supplied at this readout.

program.checker_template:
Execute the supplied check and return status, image-grounded or dependency-grounded evidence, reported confidence from 0 to 1 (or null), and used_dependency_ids.
For a support node, inspect SOURCE and EDITED only for its ONE saved visual proposition. Return pass/fail/unknown according to the criteria; fail is usable negative evidence, not automatic uncertainty. Never assess overall fulfillment or predict an expected label. used_dependency_ids must be [] because the evidence checks are independent.
For a requested node, NO IMAGES are supplied. Use ALL and ONLY the saved dependency observations for visual evidence, together with the original instruction, rubric, binding and saved composition criteria. Return complete/partial/absent/unknown. Explain how the dependency observations support the selected state, naming their IDs. used_dependency_ids must list every supplied dependency check_id exactly once in the saved order. Do not invent visual observations, silently replace dependency findings, or count supporting facts as completed edits. If necessary evidence is missing or contradictory, return unknown. Confidence is self-report, not a calibrated probability.

response.content: {"accepted":false,"reason":"The readout cannot faithfully distinguish partial progress from absence using the saved observations. n2 can pass based on basketball props or court-like alterations, while n4 only checks for a court-like surface or markings and does not establish that the background change itself progressed. The readout also treats n1 fail plus n2 fail as absent even if n4 passes, discarding potentially relevant evidence. Thus the supports are not sufficient for a faithful, evidence-only fulfillment judgment."}
